amended_tasks.title: Implement the core Skill Tree Plugins management operation
Implement extensible all-operation and named plugin bindings
Specify plugin selection and consent behavior for installation
Compose selected plugin hooks into standalone operations
Implement resumable plugin invocation and result receipts
Expose the installed plugin registry and exact-ID removal
Integrate post-processing task wording, interviews and rework
Implement confirmed recommended and alternative plugin installation

limits: The amendment validates planned task specifications rather than implementing plugin sequencing.
owner_direction: Configure arbitrary plugin order and repeated identical plugins at one entry point during installation or later skill-tree-plugins use; the supplied processing example is editorial A, interview B with task additions, editorial C.
requirements: Independent stable occurrence IDs and configurable order for all compatible plugins.
Same package repeats at one anchor without duplicate resource installation.
Per-occurrence parameters, conditions, enabled state, move and exact removal.
Sequential accepted-context forwarding and occurrence-specific receipts/resume.
Same-binding replay and true recursive re-entry remain guarded; finite repeated packages remain valid.
Initial setup and later management share exact chain preview/confirmation.
Required final acceptance/freshness and frozen parked configuration remain binding.
scope: Owner-approved clarification of existing unstarted Ready tasks; no new Pending, task root, implementation or runtime activation.
